title: Homepage hero CTA smoke (golden sample)
objective: Verify the homepage loads and the primary hero CTA is visible, accessible, and routes to the contact form without errors.

source_refs.title: Homepage hero CTA routes to contact form

model_verification.note: Live model/tool verification requires GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY and network access; record verified model IDs/date during 008.4 spike or production setup.

preconditions.description: Target site https://testradius.dev is reachable from the execution environment.
No user authentication is required for the homepage and contact navigation path.

test_data.name: expected_cta_text
test_data.description: Primary hero CTA label (adjust if product copy differs; treat minor copy drift per oracle_notes).

stop_conditions: captcha or bot protection blocks progress
data_handling: Do not submit real personal data
redaction_rules: Redact any accidental credential-like text in evidence notes

cases.title: Homepage loads and hero CTA is actionable

steps.intent: Open the homepage and confirm the page has loaded.

target.description: Browser address/navigation to the site root

success_criteria: Browser URL is https://testradius.dev/ or an equivalent canonical homepage URL on the same allowed domain.
A visible primary page heading or hero region is rendered (not a blank page, DNS error, or 4xx/5xx error page).
failure_signals: Blank white page with no visible content
fallback_instructions: If navigation stalls, refresh once and wait up to 20s for main content.
If a cookie/consent banner appears, record it and continue if it does not block the hero.

steps.intent: Locate the primary hero call-to-action and verify it is visible.

target.description: Primary hero CTA button/link near the top hero section

success_criteria: A primary CTA element with text matching or closely matching {{test_data.expected_cta_text}} is visible in the hero region.
The CTA is not obscured by overlays/modals and appears enabled/clickable.
fallback_instructions: Scroll to top and look again for hero CTAs.
If text differs slightly, match by primary prominence in hero and record actual label.

steps.intent: Click the primary hero CTA and verify navigation to the contact flow.

target.description: Primary hero CTA identified in previous step

success_criteria: After activation, browser navigates to a contact page/section (URL contains /contact or an equivalent contact destination on testradius.dev) OR a contact form/modal is visibly displayed.
At least one contact form field (name, email, or message) or a clear contact form heading is visible after the action.
failure_signals: No navigation or UI change after click
fallback_instructions: If first click has no effect, wait 2s and retry once.
If CTA opens same-page anchor/section, scroll to the revealed contact form and verify fields.

postconditions: No test data submitted; browser can be closed.
cleanup: Close browser/tab and discard session state.
oracle_notes: Minor marketing copy changes are acceptable if the hero CTA remains primary and routes to contact.
Pass requires observable navigation or visible contact form; a click with no observable effect is a failure.
execution_hints_for_computer_use: Prefer visible labels, roles, and regions over pixel coordinates.
Verify the page has finished loading enough to show main content before interacting.
If a modal or cookie banner blocks interaction, dismiss it only if safe and necessary, then record the action.
Capture failure screenshots before stopping a case.

coverage_notes: Covers QA-812 core CTA navigation behavior; visual copy drift handled via oracle notes.
